title: ZMeta Event v1.2.0
description: Canonical envelope for a ZMeta event. v1.2.0 adds four backward-compatible additions over v1.1.0: event.correlation, event.payload_schema_uri, event.payload_cardinality, and payload.media[]. All additions are optional; v1.1.0 senders' messages remain valid v1.2.0 messages.

zmeta_version.description: Spec version this event targets. Senders SHOULD set '1.2.0' when emitting v1.2 fields; v1.2-aware consumers MUST accept '1.1.0' senders verbatim.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance. Typically a UUID.

event_type.description: Top-level event category. Unchanged from v1.1.0.

event_subtype.description: Domain-specific discriminator under event_type. Free-form by spec; see spec/subtype-registry-seed.md for proposed common values.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the event happened (NOT publication time).

correlation.description: NEW in v1.2: cross-sensor correlation identity, populated by a fusion engine. Absent until the entity has been correlated. See spec/correlation-semantics.md.

correlation_id.description: Stable identifier for the real-world entity this event is about. Assigned by the fusion engine; persists across sensor handoffs.

primary_alias.description: Most-specific known identifier (e.g., MMSI preferred over ICAO24 preferred over an internal track id).

aliases.description: All known aliases for this entity, across all schemes.

confidence.description: Fusion engine's confidence in this correlation.

fusion_revision.description: Bumps every time the set of bonded contributors changes.

payload_schema_uri.description: NEW in v1.2: URI pointing at the schema the `payload` conforms to. ZMeta does not host payload schemas; this field merely identifies them. See spec/payload-typing.md.

payload_cardinality.description: NEW in v1.2: declares whether the payload describes one entity or a snapshot of many. When 'snapshot', validators require payload.entries[]. See spec/payload-typing.md.

source.description: The platform that produced this event.

platform_id.description: Stable identifier for the source platform (sensor, service, ingestor).

payload.description: Domain-specific event payload. Validated against `event.payload_schema_uri` if provided. When `event.payload_cardinality == 'snapshot'`, MUST contain `entries[]`.

entries.description: Required when payload_cardinality is 'snapshot'. Each item is one entity in the snapshot.

media.description: NEW in v1.2: standardized convention for binary attachments. Each entry references an out-of-band blob (with optional inline preview). See spec/media-attachments.md.

scheme.description: Identifier scheme. Common values: MMSI, ICAO24, callsign, internal.

value.description: The identifier value under the named scheme.

ref.description: Where to fetch the binary. URL (http/https), URI (mqtt-blob/ipfs/etc.), or relative path. Consumers fetch lazily.

content_type.description: RFC-6838 media type, or a custom application/x-* type for project-specific formats.

size_bytes.description: Size of the referenced blob, if known.

etag.description: Strong identifier for the blob's content. Consumers MAY use as a cache key. Recommended format: 'sha256:HEX'.

valid_until.description: If set, the ref is expected to be valid only until this ISO-8601 timestamp.

preview.description: Optional inline preview as a data URI. RECOMMENDED only when the encoded preview is <= 4 KB.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata about the blob (bbox, resolution, framerate, etc.). Schema is content_type-specific.
